prompt: A dwarven hold carved inside the mountain: great halls, forges and deep mines.

card.name: Deepforge Hold

site.text: A hold carved inside the mountain, with halls and tunnels cut into the rock and an entrance in the mountainside.

style.text: Dwarven: dark stone, deepslate and polished blackstone, gold accents, lava and lantern light, heavy carved pillars.

purpose.text: A dwarven hold for living, crafting and mining: great halls, forges and deep mines.

card.interpretation: You want a dwarven hold inside a mountain. I took the site as an underground settlement cut into existing mountain rock, large in size, with a dwarven look of dark stone, gold and lava light. Its purpose is living and working: great halls, forges and deep mines, so the program centres on a great hall, a grand forge and a mine head, with homes, barracks, a mead hall and a gate.
assumptions: Size L, since a hold with halls, forges and mines is large.
Terrain: find an existing mountain rather than sculpt one.
Medium density and patron difficulty from the settings.
No backstory given, so none added.

program.notes: Vast pillared feast and moot hall with long tables, a high seat and braziers.
Lava-fed forges, anvils and quenching channels; the hold's heart of industry.
Smaller workshops for tools, armour and gem-cutting.
Lift and shaft down to the deep mines, with minecart rails and ore sorting.
Furnaces and stockpiles of ore and ingots beside the mine head.
Rock-cut family homes with stone beds, hearths and carved doors.
Guard quarters near the main gate, with weapon racks.
Barrels and a stone hearth for off-shift miners.
Massive carved stone doors set in the mountainside.
